messages:
maya: heads up — we started seeing a steady uptick in 95th latency on /embeddings last hour, ~300ms -> 620ms with concurrent small requests.
sam: saw the alert. graphs show a lot of tiny requests (single short strings) spiking the scheduler. preflight shows shape missing for many clients.
maya: exactly. clients aren't sending dim hints so splitter is over-fragmenting and backpressure gets weird. Suggest we surface a console suggestion to encourage `X-Embed-Shape` header and show per-tenant suggested batch size.
devon: +1. We should also add a soft-shed proposal: when tenant exceeds N tiny-rps, route a % of requests to a batching tier with a small delay (50–100ms) instead of failing. That buys throughput without changing client behavior.
liam: how would we signal that in the console? tooltip or notice on the route? Also need to avoid confusing customers who care about strict latency SLOs.
sam: proposal: in Routes > Embeddings, show: "Detected frequent small payloads. We recommend enabling 'Smart Batch Hints' (non-breaking) — adds up to 100ms latency but reduces token cost by ~30%." with toggle + per-tenant rollout.
maya: telemetry question — can we estimate the cost delta per-tenant automatically? i.e., show projected token savings per month if they enable smart batching.
sre-jen: ops-bot ping — can we add a derived metric: "small_request_rate" (requests < 128 bytes) per tenant + 95th latency; tie an alert when small_request_rate > 500 rps && p95 > 400ms.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-842. Added alert rule to staging: small_request_rate > 500 & p95_latency > 400ms (notify #eng-oncall). :white_check_mark:
sam: SDK change optional: we can auto-populate `X-Embed-Shape` from a fast local hashing of payload length in the JS SDK; opt-in by default in next release.
devon: console UX detail: show a preflight validator that highlights mismatched shapes with inline sample requests. e.g., sample row:

```
POST /v1/embeddings
Headers: {"X-Embed-Shape": "768", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
Body: {"input": ["short text 1", "short text 2"]}
```

If mismatched shapes exist suggest `autoset-shape` toggle.
liam: what about quota accounting? if we batch many small requests into single model batch, do we bill per-request or per-token? customers will want clarity.
maya: billing stays per-embedding-unit as before. But console should show an "estimated unit savings" line that explains the math: "Estimated units saved = current_units - projected_units_with_batching" and link to docs.
sam: rollout plan: feature gated behind `smart_batch_v1`. Start with internal tenants, then a small opt-in field trial (5% traffic) for customers with high small_request_rate.
devon: also need a fallback for clients that depend on strict ordering/latency — a per-route override to disable batching for specific API keys.
liam: agree. Add a UI control: "Prefer throughput (batching) / Prefer latency (no batching)" per API key.
maya: can we get a quick spike runbook? steps:
1) enable staging alert (done)
2) enable smart_batch_v1 on a staging tenant
3) run synthetic 1000rps of tiny requests and measure p95 and cost
4) record graphs in dashboard

Can someone own step 3? @devon?
devon: I'll run the synthetic test after lunch. Will post results + perf traces.
sam: I'll draft the console strings and the projected savings formula. putting a short PR up for review in ~2h.
maya: perfect — thanks. if anyone sees regressions tag @sre-jen and I'll spin up a rollback flag.
liam: tiny nit — add a 'why this matters' paragraph in the console copy, customers don't read technical terms :sweat_smile:
maya: noted. we'll make it plain english.
ops-bot: Updated INC-2024-842 status -> in_progress (assignee: devon).
